name: Intake Chase
job: Chase the medical intake survey for booked contacts. SMS-only (+4h, +20h). Enrolled by WF-03 hand-off; no other trigger.

trigger.notes: Sole enroll path is ADD-TO-WF from WF-03. There is no dedicated intake URL contact field yet; SMS bodies reference contact.current_booking_url as the manage / complete-intake link.

named_steps.name: SMS: Intake chase +4h + STOP (WF-04)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Uses {{contact.current_booking_url}} as the manage / complete-intake link.

named_steps.name: SMS: Intake chase +20h (WF-04)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Final nudge before the workflow completes.
